acceptance: The TPC-DS power-withhold test passes on both Windows legs because run_power_test honors the module clock
The bundled-qgen stream test skips instead of FileNotFoundError on Windows where the binary is not runnable
The chDB tuning test skips instead of ImportError on Windows where chDB is not installed
context:
Root causes diagnosed 2026-10-13/14 from nightly.yml run 38404921532 evidence (handoff section 0.5): (1) run_power_test did a function-local `import time`, defeating the test's runner.time monkeypatch; Windows time.time() granularity puts 99 instant mock queries inside one tick, so total_time is exactly 0.0 and power stays 0.0. Proven with a frozen-clock probe in /tmp. (2) get_binary_path returns an existing-but-extensionless qgen on Windows and the test execs bare `qgen`, which Windows cannot resolve (WinError 2). (3) ClickHouseLocalAdapter raises ImportError when chdb is absent; the test only patched the server-mode dep check. Branch fix/windows-unit-failures in ../BenchBox.wt-windows-unit-failures implemented all three narrowly with local tests green (62 + 41 + 26 passed; ruff clean; pr-preflight 199 passed).

2026-10-14 closeout: oracle verdict "no soundness path changed" (run 38557921062), oracle-review pass, full CI green (run 38557921012, CLEAN); merged via PR #2959 as 790a5065f6b64ae4ddf4595c70642a716871bdf3 at 2026-10-14T12:11:56Z. Acceptance 4 (nightly Windows leg green) still needs a post-merge nightly run; closing the code item now, leg evidence follows on nightly-v2-windows-unit-leg-20261009.
description: Three Windows-only unit failures (TPC-DS power clock, bundled qgen lookup, chDB import) fail the nightly Windows legs with no owning item. Fix narrowly: drop the shadowing local import, skip when the binary is not runnable, skip when chDB is absent.
